main_text.p: noƈte & tenebris, ad vita & luminis auras
ecce tuba reuocat sonitu officiosa potentes
meritas, sanctéque pio certamine functas.
Ipse Pater amplexu non dedignatus amico,
arbitrio fati exemptas, Regumque furori,
in cælum Pater Omnipotens excepit quantes.
Quare agite & sacris etiam nunc accentibus omnes
in numerum, denfa toto date carmina cœlo:
solo, ubi perpetuas ales chorus haurit anhelans
delicias, puraque bibunt noua gaudia mentes:
gaudia nil humile aut fluxum spirantia porrò,
gaudia parta pijs atque obseruantibus æqui.
Veftra sed hæc olim memores exempla sequuti
ite cœlum repetant gratique piique nepotes,
Qui dederint ultro dura sua nomina Christi
Militia, sancta cum maiestate malorum
tot lati gladios, & tot crudelia passi.
Hæc Sobis magè marmoribus vel mole superba
pyramidum, longos perduratura per annos
sancta pijs incisa notis monimenta parauit
Hierópolis: Verbis etiam Crispinus amico
iusta facit voto, & patrio sermone parentat.
Quòd si ego nil aliud potero, vos carmine saltem
profequar, & Siticen memorabo funera plausu.
Veftra pio, & veftras comitabor carmine flamas.
Ergo, liber, populos procul ex Oriente remotos,
qua patet orbe olim Romana potentia sicto,
ad Tanain, ad Cimmerios, atque vltima Ponti,
Aurem à Iura peragra, viridique Lemano.

page.notes: Several words in the first lines are doubtful, notably the Latin with long-s forms and the abbreviation marks; the text is printed in a heavy, irregular face. Reading of "ite cœlum" and "Sobis" uncertain. Marks such as "[?]" were not added individually; the transcription follows the scan as closely as possible.
